data.headline: Sculpted in Leather, Defined by Function.
storyParagraphs: Zimor was born in 2024 from an uncompromising need: why should modern women choose between delicate designer aesthetics and the pragmatic demands of a high-power workday?

Our journey began in a boutique leather studio, obsessing over internal weight distribution, padded 15.6" shock-absorbing sleeves, and French equestrian saddle stitches that withstand a lifetime of use.
Today, Zimor represents deliberate, quiet luxury. Every edge is meticulously hand-painted, every brass bottom stud is turned on a lathe, and every pocket is mapped to modern daily tech.

data.vision: To redefine modern luxury workwear by elevating functional carry into an art form of sculptural minimalism.
data.mission: Handcrafting architectural, cruelty-free leather goods in India with uncompromising structural durability, transparent pricing, and zero aesthetic sacrifice.

data.warranty: Every Zimor bag is covered by our 1-Year Master Craftsmanship Warranty covering stitching, hardware, and structural edges.
data.shipping: We offer complimentary express air shipping across India on all orders. Standard delivery arrives within 3-5 business days.
data.returns: 7-day hassle-free return and exchange policy on unused items in original packaging.
